payload.core_mechanism_summary: For each starting index, expand left while non-increasing and expand right while non-increasing, count watered cells, and take maximum.
payload.rationale: The solution iterates over all n positions, performing a linear scan to compute the number of watered sections if rain falls at that position. This is a straightforward complete search over the starting positions; no recursive backtracking or bitmask enumeration is used. However, among the provided subtypes, search_backtracking is the most generic complete search subtype, even though the implementation is iterative.
